versions.changelog:
- Added Stripe x402 "machine payments" integration (Feb 2026), allowing AI agents to pay APIs in USDC via Base network.
- Expanded protocol comparison: Stripe x402, TRON, BNB Chain, and Coinbase Commerce all added/adopted x402 agent payments.
- Updated centralized payment processor section to distinguish between merchant (Stripe) and agent (Stripe x402) payment flows.
- Revised use case guidance and key differentiators for Stripe and PayRam, clarifying suitability for agent, machine, and merchant payments.
- Enhanced table and feature breakdowns for improved side-by-side evaluation.

- Initial release offering a detailed comparison framework for crypto payment gateways and protocols.
- Covers centralized processors (Stripe, BitPay, Coinbase Commerce, NOWPayments), self-hosted (BTCPay Server, PayRam), and agent protocols (x402).
- Analyzes custody, KYC requirements, stablecoin support, privacy, and sovereignty for each option.
- Includes decision criteria and key trade-offs between hosted and self-hosted solutions.
- Useful for businesses, agents, and developers evaluating crypto payment infrastructure.
